answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tide of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
